states.title: States / marine codes
states.description: Two-letter state or marine-zone codes, e.g. TX, CA, FL. Empty = the whole US. Only one location filter applies per run: point beats zones beats states.

point.title: Point (latitude,longitude)
point.description: Alerts covering a single location, e.g. 39.7,-104.9 for Denver. Overrides states and zones when set.

zones.title: NWS zone IDs
zones.description: Specific NWS forecast or county zone IDs, e.g. TXZ211, COC031. Overrides states when set.

events.title: Event names (optional)
events.description: Only these alert types, matched by exact NWS event name (case-insensitive), e.g. Tornado Warning, Flood Warning, Winter Storm Warning, Excessive Heat Warning. Empty = all events.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Keep only these severity levels. Empty = all.

urgency.title: Urgency
urgency.description: Keep only these urgency levels. Empty = all.

certainty.title: Certainty
certainty.description: Keep only these certainty levels. Empty = all.

status.title: Status
status.description: Alert status. Actual is real alerts; the others are test/exercise messages.

maxRows.title: Max alerts per run
maxRows.description: Cap on alert rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip alerts seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned alerts across runs and skip them. Turn on with a schedule for a live new-alerts feed.
